title: Install Python
text:
## Windows / macOS / Linux

```
# Windows (winget)
winget install Python.Python.3.12

# macOS (Homebrew)
brew install [email protected]

# Verify
python --version
```
breadcrumb: Overview > Dev Tooling Setup > Install Python

title: Install Python
text:
## Create a virtual environment

```
python -m venv .venv
# Windows:  .venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux:  source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

title: Set up GitHub & GitLab
text:
## Configure git

```
git config --global user.name "Your Name"
git config --global user.email "[email protected]"
```
breadcrumb: Overview > Dev Tooling Setup > Set up GitHub & GitLab

title: Set up GitHub & GitLab
text:
## Clone repositories

```
git clone https://github.com/org/repo.git
git clone https://gitlab.com/org/repo.git
```

Use SSH keys or a personal access token for authentication.
breadcrumb: Overview > Dev Tooling Setup > Set up GitHub & GitLab

title: Enable Copilot
text:
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Owner | Platform Team |
| Status | REVIEW |
| Last reviewed | 2026-08-16 |
| Audience | Internal |

1. Install the GitHub Copilot extension in VS Code
2. Sign in with your GitHub account
3. Authorize Copilot for your organization
4. Start typing — accept suggestions with Tab

Copilot access requires an active license assigned by your admin.
breadcrumb: Overview > Dev Tooling Setup > Enable Copilot
